selection: All November-February MLB free-agent signings in the official winter tracker, with verified guaranteed annual cash and no exercisable options. Multi-year list fixed before prediction review. All unavailable cash schedules and other exclusions retained. Earlier inspected diagnostic cases are development data.
cash_convention: Guaranteed annual cash including signing bonuses, buyouts and explicitly scheduled deferrals; excludes incentives. Discounted at the same annual rate as production. Exact within-year payment dates are approximated.
